title: The multitrack arrangement test registers in one timeline suite so every ctest name is unique

needles: ## Register a test source in one suite only
Every ctest entry in the build must have a unique name

installed_sdk.rationale: Test registration only: no header, target, or installed artifact changes. The timeline example implementation still compiles in the phase-1 aggregate; only the Catch2 test source stops being compiled twice.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: No CLI verb, flag, handler, or document shape changes; the change is which ctest executable runs an existing test file.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No MCP tool definition, schema entry, or handler changes.

live_product_control.rationale: No capability, operation, executor binding, grant, or profile policy changes.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: docs/status/agent-capabilities.json is unchanged; deduplicating ctest names is CI test topology, not a design-time capability.
